newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's St Petersburg Telephone eyes capital rise.
newsitem.headline: Russia's St Petersburg Telephone eyes capital rise.

text.p: AO Peterburgskaya Telefonnaya Set (PTS) will consider a capital increase and possible share issue at a shareholders' meeting on April 18, a company official said on Wednesday.
"If shareholders approve the volume of shares to be issued the authorised capital will be increased by that amount," Nikolai Bredkov, St Petersburg Telephone deputy director told Reuters.
He refused to mention the size of the rise.
On the Russian Trading System, PTS fell to $1.77 from $1.85 on Tuesday.
